texts.preamble: M/S.Modern Laboratories 2 Others vs The State Of A.P., Rep. By P.P. Anr on 8 October, 2018 Smt Justice T. Rajani Criminal Petition No.9831 of 2013 Order:
texts.facts: This criminal petition is filed, seeking for quash of the proceedings in C.C.No.326 of 2002, against the petitioners, who are A1 to A3, on the file of the II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Hyderabad at Nampally. The case of the prosecution is that on 18.09.2009, the Drugs Inspector inspected the Medical Stores, Sir Ronald Ross Institute of Tropical and Communicable Diseases, Nallakunta, Hyderabad and picked up 4 items of drugs for test and sent one of the sealed portions of Dexamethasone Sodium Phosphate Injection, Manufacturing date October, 1998 and Expiry date March 2000, to the Government Analyst, Drugs Control Laboratory, Hyderabad for test/analysis on 20.09.1999. The report dated 30.11.1999 was received on 01.12.1999. The complaint was filed in the year 2002, which is after the expiry of the drug.
